data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Farizaht is derived from the root words ‘faraza’ meaning to exalt, honor, or respect, and ‘zah’ meaning to grow, increase, or elevate. This name is a beautiful reflection of a woman who is revered, respected, and held in high regard by all. The name Farizaht carries the meaning “Exalted, Noble, Respectable” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Farizaht usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, noble, respectable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
